cohort: 61 women who gave birth at Santosh Hospital, a Level 3 COVID facility in Ghaziabad, India, between June 2020 and October 2020.
finding: 24.5% of women experienced postnatal depression during the COVID-19 pandemic, and factors such as postnatal complications, COVID-19 symptoms, separation from newborn, extended postpartum stay, and inability to connect with family were significantly correlated with higher depression scores.
